principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class handles both payment processing logic and order updating. This combines two responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order status update and payment processing into distinct methods or classes to adhere to the Single Responsibility Principle.

principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class is not easily extensible for handling multiple payment methods while maintaining existing functionality.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an abstraction for payment processing to enable the addition of new payment methods without altering existing code.
